tools.name: create-recipe
tools.description: Create a recipe page on Instacart Marketplace

image_url.description: URL of the recipe image (500x500 pixels)

servings.description: Number of servings the recipe makes

instructions.description: List of instructions for preparing the recipe

unit.description: Unit of measurement (e.g., cup, tablespoon, ounce)

displayText.description: Optional display text for the ingredient

ingredients.description: List of ingredients (at least one required)

tools.name: create-shopping-list
tools.description: Create a shopping list page on Instacart Marketplace

image_url.description: URL of the shopping list image (500x500 pixels)

expires_in.description: Number of days the shopping list expires in. If not provided, the shopping list will never expire.

instructions.description: List of instructions for preparing the shopping list

quantity.description: Quantity of the line item. If not provided, the line item will not be added to the shopping list.

unit.description: Unit of measurement (e.g., cup, tablespoon, ounce). If not provided, the line item will not be added to the shopping list.

displayText.description: Optional display text for the line item

lineItems.description: List of line items (at least one required)

enablePantryItems.description: Enable pantry items. Items identified as a pantry item will not be automatically added to the shopping list.

landingPageConfiguration.description: The configuration for the landing page
